A '''town''' was located on the planet of [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]] and was home to the [[Ming Po/Legends|Ming Po]]. Several of its buildings were burnt by the [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]] of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] led by [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]].
